verdict_reason: Two Major gaps: AC4 does not assert Address/Country cell values, and AC8 never clicks Add a new address to verify navigation from the list.

todos.issue: AC4 e2e asserts Name cell and column headers but never the Address or Country cell values, so a regression that blanks or mis-maps those columns would still pass.
todos.fix: Also assert table cells for stub address line '1 Stub Way, Stubton, ST1 1UB' and country 'United Kingdom'.

todos.issue: AC8 entry from the list is untested: both list cases only assert 'Add a new address' is visible, and no suite clicks it to reach /address-book/add (add.e2e navigates via goto).
todos.fix: Click the Add control and expect navigation to /address-book/add (and the Add address details heading).
